Michael Wolff is the author of Fire and Fury, the number one Sunday Times and New York Times bestseller that for the first time told the inside story of the Trump White House. He has received numerous awards for his work, including two National Magazine Awards. The author of seven previous books, he has been a regular columnist for
Vanity Fair, New York, The Hollywood Reporter, British GQ, and other magazines and newspapers.
Matthew d'Ancona is an editor at Tortoise Media and an award-winning columnist. He writes for The Guardian, London Evening Standard and GQ. He was previously editor of The Spectator and founding editor-in-chief of Drugstore Culture. His most recent book, Post-Truth: The New War on Truth and How to Fight Back, received global
acclaim.
